title: Sarah Hope
text:
Welcome! I am a PhD Student at the University of Massachusetts Dartmouth School for Marine Science and Technology. I am a member of the Fay Lab, where we do research on quantitative methods in fisheries science and ecosystem based fisheries management.
My academic research is focused on the modeling the social-ecological trade-offs in fisheries. I use a range of approaches to do this, including both quantitative and qualitative modeling, management strategy evaluation, and social science methods.
I also work in service to my community to increase access to seafood, facilitate connection to food systems, strengthen mutual aid networks, and build worker solidarity.
